framework_lessons: Separate easier production from who captures profits.
assessment: The strongest call is the multi-year Bitcoin direction and the strongest technology diagnosis is real AI adoption. Adobe illustrates why operating success is distinct from shareholder returns; the TSM/Nvidia relative preference faces adverse three-year evidence. Gold-certificate accounting omits a statutory constraint. Several AI claims are open scenarios or decade-long expectations, not settled wins.

Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
